scenario.summary: Enters a product SKU in the template pad, a template name and quantity 1, clicks Add to Template, then Clear All without saving.
steps: Type product1's SKU, pick it from the suggestions
Set quantity 1 for the first product
assertions: Add to Template and Clear All work without saving
evidence: Class chain: navigateToRegistrationPage -> verifySuccessfulRegistration -> verifyOrderTemplateLinkNavigation -> verifyCreateTemplateButtonIsPresentAndClickable -> (verifyCreateTemplateLabels, verifyProductIsAddedWithSKU -> verifyCreateNewTemplate -> verifyEditViewCartIconIsVisible -> (verifyItemsCountBeforeEdit, verifyEditTemplate -> (verifyItemsCountAfterEdit, verifyLineItemRemove, verifyAddingProductToCart -> (verifyPlaceOrder, verifyDeleteCreatedTemplate)))); verifyAddRowsForSKU and clickOnLogOffLink run by priority. The session is the account verifySuccessfulRegistration creates (created-by-test), so no method declares an account.

First method captures: verifyProductIsAddedWithSKU is the first method that uses product records and declares product1..product3 (orderTemplateData productSKU1..3); the migrated class keeps them in class fields and later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when null).

product1..product3: orderTemplateData productSKU1 z-2300014 (myAccount!C47, 'American Standard Astume Vortax Toilet', Simple, DontTrackInventory, tda rows); productSKU2/3 (C48/C49) are read inside OrderTemplate.verifyAddMultipleProductsWithSKUsAndQuantity by verifyCreateNewTemplate (not scanned). The template then holds 3 lines of quantity 1 (items count 3); verifyEditTemplate sets the first line to 100 (items count 102), the line goes to the cart and is ordered -> three distinct PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 100, minMaxQuantity 100, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0 (the template pad, like Quick Order, rejects personalizable products), store}; product1 preferred the sheet SKU (not required). 100 on all three because the edit grid's first line need not be product1. Readiness 2026-11-11: the sheet SKU z-2300014 does not qualify (MaximumQuantity 100, but DontTrackInventory with stock 10 per warehouse < quantityUsed 100), so the resolver falls back to a simple product with stock >= 100.
templateName/Input 'Automation Template' names the template the test creates -> created-by-test; productQuantity/Input 1 -> config.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map keys, delays, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
